get_predict_unit: get a pretrained MLIP prediction unit for a specified model name with inference settings
pretrained_checkpoint_path_from_name: download and return the local checkpoint file path for a pretrained model by name
get_reference_energies: retrieve atomic or form elemental reference energies for a pretrained model from HuggingFace
HuggingFaceCheckpoint: review the HuggingFaceCheckpoint dataclass that stores model filename, repo id, subfolder, and reference data
available_models: list all available pretrained model names from the fairchem core calculate module
